A survival assistant that works 100% without internet — on Windows, Linux and macOS. 🇧🇷 Português · 🇺🇸 English · 🇪🇸 Español If the internet, power and services go down, this kit keeps working on a laptop or USB drive: ⚠️ Disclaimer: educational content. It does not replace doctors, firefighters or emergency services. Health guidance follows public guidelines (WHO, Red Cross/IFRC, AHA, CDC, Hesperian…) cited in each section. Question ──► search kit guides (BM25) ──────┐ └─► search Kiwix (.zim files) ──────┼─► local language model ──► answer with [1] [2] sources └─► (no model? shows the most relevant passages) Part What it is Where sobrevivencia.py + app/ The AI (Python standard library only, no pip install ) repository `knowledge/pt en es/` knowledge/extra/ Your .md / .txt documents (searched and cited by the AI) repository runtime/llama.cpp/ Engine that runs the AI model downloaded by the preparer models/*.gguf Language model (1–5 GB) downloaded by the preparer runtime/kiwix-tools/ + zim/*.zim Kiwix server and libraries downloaded by the preparer runtime/python/ Portable Python (for PCs without Python) downloaded by the preparer Large files are not committed to git (see .gitignore ): the repository stays small and everyone builds their own kit with the preparer. git clone https://github.com/sdalberto/ia-da-sobrevivencia.git cd ia-da-sobrevivencia 2. Prepare the kit (online, once) System How to run Windows double-click preparar-kit.bat macOS double-click preparar-kit.command (first time: right-click › Open) Linux ./preparar-kit.sh --lang en The preparer asks for: Non-interactive: python sobrevivencia.py --lang en prepare --model padrao --zims recomendado --os all --python 3. Use it (offline) System How to open Windows iniciar.bat --lang en (or double-click iniciar.bat and press EN ) macOS iniciar.command Linux ./iniciar.sh --lang en Your browser opens http://127.0.0.1:8090 . Switch language anytime with the PT/EN/ES buttons. To make English the default, create config/settings.local.json with { "language": "en" } . Copy the whole folder to a USB drive or external disk formatted as exFAT (works on all three systems and supports files over 4 GB). python sobrevivencia.py --lang en chat # terminal chat python sobrevivencia.py --lang en ask " how do I make oral rehydration solution? " python sobrevivencia.py --lang en search burn python sobrevivencia.py status python sobrevivencia.py start --host 0.0.0.0 # share on the local network python sobrevivencia.py prepare --search survival # find more Kiwix libraries Ollama: if you use Ollama , run ollama pull qwen2.5:3b — it is detected automatically. Any local OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio, llamafile, KoboldCpp, Jan) also works: set llm_url . Kiwix Desktop: Kiwix Desktop can open the .zim files in zim/ . To let the AI use its Local Kiwix Server , set { "kiwix_url": "http://127.0.0.1:<port>" } in config/settings.local.json . The Windows Kiwix Desktop package (~150 MB) exceeds GitHub's 100 MB per-file limit — publish it as a Release asset instead of committing it. Drop .md or .txt files in knowledge/extra/ (family recipes, local maps, contacts, equipment manuals). They are indexed and cited by the AI. python -m unittest discover -s tests Licenses Code: MIT . The default model (Qwen2.5 3B) uses the Qwen Research License ; for commercial use choose leve or forte (Apache 2.0).
